# Elijärven Mökkilomat

> Six holiday cottages for 5–12 guests and a smoke sauna around Lake Elijärvi in Yläne, Pöytyä, Southwest Finland (Varsinais-Suomi), 12 km from Yläne village and 65 km from Turku. Book directly with the owner, Mika Merilä, by phone or email.

- Address: Meriläntie 24, 21900 Yläne, Finland
- Phone: +358 400 534 973, +358 2 256 8604
- Email: mikameri@netti.fi
- A boat and firewood are included with every cottage.
- Weekly stays change over on Saturday. Arrival from 16:00, departure by 12:00.

## Cottages (weekly price, summer weeks 25–32 / lowest week / weekend outside peak weeks)
- Elimäki: sleeps 12. Round-log villa high on a hill by the lake, separate shore sauna with an open fireplace, slate fireplace, "starry sky" ceiling, two covered terraces, private hot tub for 11 (€150). €950 / €650 / €330. Hauenkuonontie 128.
- Meritähti: sleeps 8. Two-storey log cottage with a balcony at Kotolahti. €700 / €450 / €250.
- Merenneito: sleeps 8. Log cottage at Kotolahti with indoor sauna, loft and balcony; the Kotolahti shore has a jetty and rowing boat. €700 / €450 / €250.
- Meripoika: sleeps 5. Small log cottage with a glazed terrace, indoor sauna. €550 / €400 / €200.
- Pöytäkallio: sleeps 6. Cottage on rocky ground among pines with a lake view, brick fireplace, wood-fired sauna. €500 / €400 / €200. Jävänlahdentie 9.
- Fransula: sleeps 6. The most affordable cottage, on the Säkylä side on Koivulantie. €350 / €300 / €150.

## Smoke sauna
On the farm's own pond, with an island grill shelter reached by an arched bridge and crayfish in the pond. Up to 10 people, €160 per time. Can be rented separately, for example for company days and crayfish parties.

## Extras
Hot tub barrel €150, canoe €20/day or €75/week, SUP board €25/day, outboard motor €15/day + fuel, bicycle €15/day, bed linen €12.50/person, final cleaning €65–95. Guided trips, adventure services, crayfishing and catering by agreement.

## Nearby
Kuhankuono trail network, Kurjenrahka National Park, Pukkipalo old-growth forest, Vaskijärvi Strict Nature Reserve.
